title: Project Eleven Launches Strongpoint Post-Quantum Custody Platform with Zcash Foundation as Initial Development Partner - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Project Eleven launched Strongpoint, an institutional post-quantum custody platform with a crypto-agile policy layer, with the Zcash Foundation as initial development partner and production targeted for Q4 2026.

insights.claim: Project Eleven's Strongpoint is an institutional custody platform designed as a crypto-agile control layer that decouples key management, transaction approval and audit workflows from the underlying signature scheme.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Abstracting the signature scheme lets custodians survive chain-by-chain PQC migrations without rebuilds.

insights.claim: Strongpoint's policy engine swaps schemes by configuration update and snapshots the active policy into signed payloads to maintain long-term signature verification.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Policy-bound signatures address verification of historic transactions after scheme changes.

insights.claim: Keys stay in FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSMs with M-of-N quorum approval and tamper-evident logs, and the platform supports ECDSA, ML-DSA and XMSS plus hybrid classical and post-quantum signatures.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Support for hybrid schemes eases the transition for regulated custodians.

insights.claim: Strongpoint is targeted for production deployment in Q4 2026.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A near-term launch date makes it an early mover in PQC custody.
insights.locator: targeted for production deployment in Q4 2026

insights.claim: Project Eleven's analysis of the 20 largest L1 blockchains found only 10 have published post-quantum migration proposals, roadmaps or implementation paths, spanning at least six distinct post-quantum signature schemes.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Half the top chains lack a PQC plan and the others disagree on schemes, which creates demand for abstraction layers.

insights.claim: Strongpoint is pitched as addressing this coordination bottleneck, with the Zcash Foundation contributing expertise on privacy-preserving cryptography, zero-knowledge proofs and shielded key management.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Including shielded-asset support is a differentiator for privacy-aware institutions.

insights.claim: Project Eleven completed a $20 million Series A in January 2026 and acquired Riva Labs in September 2026 to add post-quantum MPC and automated cryptanalysis to its enterprise suite.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Funding plus acquisitions show a push to become a full-stack PQC provider for digital assets.
